shortDescription: British retail sales unexpectedly rose by 0.5% in August, official figures showed on Friday.Most economists polled by Reuters had forecast a drop of 0.2% drop in sales volumes compared with July.

children: British retail sales unexpectedly rose by 0.5% in August, official figures showed on Friday.
Most economists polled by Reuters had forecast a drop of 0.2% drop in sales volumes compared with July.
